# Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit title (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, `test:`...)
- [ ] Behavioural tests added or updated (not mock-only)
- [ ] `pnpm --filter @stone-js/<pkg> test` and `pnpm --filter @stone-js/<pkg> lint` pass locally
- [ ] Changeset added if a published package changed (`pnpm changeset`; use **patch** during the 0.x beta)
- [ ] Docs updated (README and/or website page) if the public API changed
